notes: Measured 2026-10-08 on bh-glx-110-d07u08 (RevC, 130 W), tree b583043bcf4 with no experiment knobs. Per chunk size: one tracy capture of a global and a sliding layer at chunk index 1 (dense = everything but SDPA), and one host-timed replay of each layer at every chunk index to 256k (global attention slope).

Dense time per step (60 layers): 54.8 / 46.0 / 62.7 / 89.4 / 181 ms at 128 / 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 rows per device. Below 256 rows it gets slower, not faster (the short-slab paths are keyed to chunk 2048). Past 1024 rows it stops getting cheaper per row.

Global attention per layer is a line in prefix depth per chunk size, [a us, b us per prefix token], fitted by least squares over every depth (the per-depth points are in prefill-docs gemma4/perf_understand/harness/batching/model_data_revc.json) (max residual 69 µs at 1k and 2k, 0.6–0.9 ms at 8k and 16k). Sliding attention is flat with depth and includes the halo.
Device time at full clock. Long runs sit under the 130 W cap (−3 to −8% at 256k on RevC); the model has no clock term.
The last chunk of every prompt is padded to the unit (fixed trace shapes).

calibration._note: Silicon replays of three AgentX slices (bh-glx-110-d06u02, main 836bf0b + the batched prefill runtime, 2026-10-14): device time per step over this model (scale) and host time per step (busy minus trace replay), per scheduler: unit x budget, keyed by unit for one request per step and 'batched' for 2k lanes. The batched entry (bh-glx-120-c05u08, 2026-10-15) is fitted to the 12,837 serving steps of seven AgentX slice replays, each step's lanes rebuilt from the demo's step log: device time per component (dense incl. fixed, global attention per lane count, sliding attention), host time per lane count, and gap_ms, the scheduler's time between steps (admit, plan, log), which the replay's busy time leaves out but the clock does not (the unbatched factors absorb it). The 8192 / 4096 scales were refit on 2026-10-18 for the projection fidelity a server uses (LoFi from 512 rows per device; the 10-14 replays ran every projection at HiFi2): each is the old scale times the LoFi / HiFi2 step-time ratio, measured on bh-glx-120-b08u02 on two of those slices at both fidelities (8192: 0.942, 0.943; 4096: 0.980, 0.980). 2048 and the batched lanes run at HiFi2 either way.
